sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Dread of downward motion. [Borax] Pro-
fuse S7vcat on occiput and in nape of neck, during sleep.
[Calc.: Sil.] Photophobia. Lachrymation in cold air
or from cold application. Profuse scaly dandruff.
Soreness behind ears.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Tongue large, flabby, burning; must pro-
trude it to keep cool. Ringworm on tongue.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Nausea and vomiting from car-riding.
Thirst; drink little and often. [Ars.: Chin.] Is vom-
ited as soon as it reaches the stomach.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text:
Stools large and painful. Pain in n^holr
perineum. No desire until a large accumulation. After
great straining only partially expelled , recedes, crum-
bles at verge of anus. [Mag. mur.] Very offensive
odor. Excoriation of skin about anus, perineum, and
genitals. Diarrhcea ; changeable in character and color ;
after eating.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Bearing-down, as if contents of pelvis
would escape; better, rest. Desire to support parts.
Soreness of uterus. Leucorrhoea with odor of fish-
brine or old cheese. [Hepar] Vagina feels large.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Dislocated feeling in sacrum and better lying
on right side.

sections.label: Extremities
Skin
sections.text:
Dirty, greasy, brownish, wrinkled. Eczema,
fissured hands and fingers. [Petrol; Graph.]

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, moving arms backward.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Abrot. : Alum. ; Calc. ; 6 il. :
Stilph. Must not Ijc confounded with the Sanicle (pool-
root or wood march), also called Sanicula. This is used
in various nervous affections, resembling Valeriana.
It is used as a vulnerary, resolvent for sanguineous
extravasations, and as an astringent. Has not been
proved.
